Rocket Force Sergeant School of PLA

evidence.summary: CASI describes the Rocket Force NCO School in Qingzhou, Shandong, as the PLA Rocket Force’s school for non-commissioned officers, with nuclear missile, conventional missile, communications and engineering departments; it grew from a Second Artillery regiment formed in 1970 and became a separate school in 2017. CASI’s study of the Rocket Force adds that it trains more than 20,000 personnel a year and that its teaching service battalion teaches missile launch skills, with drills that include real missile launches.
The school reports to PLA Rocket Force headquarters.
